senses.gloss:
[भञ्ज्-भावादौ घञ्] 
__1 Breaking, breaking down, shattering, tearing down, splitting, dividing; भङ्गः स जिष्णोर्धृतिमुन्ममाथ [[Ki. 17. 29.]] वार्यर्गलाभङ्ग इब प्रवृत्तः [[R. 5. 45.]] 
__2 A break, fracture, breach. 
__3 Plucking off, lopping; आम्रकलिकाभङ्ग [[Ś. 6.]] 
__4 Separation, analysis. 
__5 A portion, bit, fragment, detached portion; पुष्पोच्चयः पल्लबभङ्गभिन्नः [[Ku. 3. 61]]; [[R. 16. 16.]] 
__6 Fall, downfall, decay, destruction, ruin; as in राज्य°, सत्त्ब° &c. 
__7 Breaking up, dispersion; यात्राभङ्ग [[Māl. 1.]] 
__8 Defeat, overthrow, discomfiture, rout; भग्ने भग्नमवाप्नुयात् [[Pt. 4. 41]]; प्रसभं भङ्गमभड्गुरोदयः (नयति) [[Śi. 16. 72.]] 
__9 Failure, disappointment, frustration; तत्पूर्बभङ्गे वितथप्रयत्नः [[R. 2. 42]] (v. l.); आशाभङ्ग &c. 
__10 Rejection, refusal; अभ्यर्थनाभङ्गभयेन स्पधुर्माध्यस्थमिष्टेऽप्यबलम्बतेऽर्थे [[Ku. 1. 52.]] 
__11 A chasm, fissure. 
__12 Interruption, obstacle, disturbance; निद्रा°, गति° [[Ki. 17. 29.]] 
__13 Non-performance, suspension, stoppage. 
__14 Taking to flight, flight. 
__15 
___(a) A bend, fold. 
___(b) A wave; क्षौमे भङ्गबती तरङ्गतरले फेनाम्बुतुल्ये वहन् [[Nāg. 5. 2]]; ज्वालाभङ्गैः ( = Wavelike flames) [[Nāg. 5. 21.]] 
__16 Contraction, bending, knitting; ग्रीबाभङ्गाभिरामम् [[Ś. 1. 7]]; so भ्रूभङ्ग [[U. 5. 36.]] 
__17 Going, motion. 
__18 Paralysis. 
__19 Fraud, deceit. 
__20 A canal, water-course. 
__21 A circumlocutory or round-about way of speaking or acting; see भङ्गि. 
__22 Hemp. 
__23 (With Buddhists) The constant decay taking place in the universe; constant change. 
__24 (With Jainas) A dialectical formula beginning with स्यात्. 
-Comp. 
-नयः removal of obstacles. 
-वासा turmeric. 
-सार्थ a. dishonest, fraudulent.

__1 Hemp. 
__2 An intoxicating drink prepared from hemp. 
-Comp. 
-कटम् the pollen of hemp.

a. 
(-ङ्गी f.) [भड्गाया इदम् अण्] Made of hemp, hempen.
A kind of fish; [[L. D. B.]]

भङ्गिः,
 
-ङ्गी f. 
__1 Breaking, fracture, breach, division. 
__2 Undulation. 
__3 Bending, contracting; दृग्भङ्गीभिः प्रथममथुरासंगमे चुम्बितोऽस्मि [[Ud. S. 13.]] 
__4 A wave. 
__5 A flood, current. 
__6 A crooked path, tortuous or winding course. 
__7 A circumlocutory or round-about way of [Page1182-1] speaking or acting, periphrasis; भङ्ग्यन्तरेण कथनात् [[K. P. 10]]; इति भङ्ग्या व्यज्यते-कथ्यते &c.; बहुभङ्गिबिशारदः [[Dk.]] 
__8 A pretext, disguise, semblance; यः पाञ्चजन्यप्रतिबिम्बभङ्ग्या धाराम्भसः फेनमिव व्यनक्ति [[Vikr. 1. 1.]] 
__9 Trick, fraud, deceit. 
__10 Irony. 
__11 Repartee, wit. 
__12 A step; यानादवातरददूरमहीतलेन मार्गेण भङ्गिरचितस्फटिकेन रामः [[R. 13. 69.]] 
__13 An interval. 
__14 Modesty. 
__15 A fashion or mode; नानाश्रमलतापुष्पभङ्गीरचितकुन्तलाम् [[Bm. 1. 233]]; भङ्ग्यन्तरेण ind. in an indirect manner; in another manner. 
-Comp. 
-भक्तिः f. division into a series of waves or wave-like steps, a wavy staircase; cf. [[Me. 62.]] 
-भाषणम् crooked speeches (with hidden meaning); पांसुलजनभङ्गिभाषणरतः [[Dk. 2. 8.]] 
-भूत a. resembling. 
-विकारः distortion of the features; a wry face, grimace.

a. 
__1 Frail, fragile, transient; तदपि तत्क्षणभङ्गि करोति चेत् [[Bh. 2. 92]]; Hence भङ्गित्व means ‘evanescence’; स च व्यापारो न तदात्वे सुखफलो भवति, नापि आयत्याम् । भङ्गित्बात् [[ŚB. on MS. 4. 3. 10.]] 
__2 Cast in a suit.

m. 
__1 Fracture, breach. 
__2 Bending, undulation. 
__3 Curliness. 
__4 Disguise, deceit. 
__5 Wit, irony. 
__6 Perversity.
A defect in the organs of sense.

a. [भञ्ज्-घुरच्] 
__1 Apt to break, fragile, brittle. 
__2 Frail, transitory, transient, perishable; आमरणान्ताः प्रणयाः कोपास्तत्क्षणभङ्गुराः; सर्वमुत्पादि भङ्गुरम् [[H. 1. 181]]; [[Śi. 16. 72.]] 
__3 Changeful, variable. 
__4 Crooked, bent. 
__5 Curved, curled; शशिमुखि तव भाति भङ्गुरभ्रूः [[Gīt. 10.]] 
__6 Fraudulent, dishonest, crafty. 
-रः The bend of a river. 
-Comp. 
-निश्चय a. vacillating, unsettled in mind.

Den. P. 
__1 To break to pieces, destroy. 
__2 To curl.
[भङ्गाया भवनं क्षेत्रं घञ्] A field of hemp.
